context:
Goal: a lane's lint result means the same as CI's.
Problem (rule): five PRs wait on this (#1938, #1813, #1916, #2017, #1760). Your 2026-10-26 decision says the pin moves, not the prose; `--lint` ignores `--pinned` today. The pinned design is a coordinator step with no owner ruling after Oct 26, and R44 (2026-11-11 14:05 CST) says child repos should not stick on old pinned rules.
Based on (ruling): decision action-pins-follow-sessions; R44.
Departs from: main — lane lint is local today; choosing b changes it to follow pins.

options.gain: Matches your Oct 26 decision and R44.
options.how: Lane lint keeps using the checkout's own tools; #1938 keeps only its small fixes and #1813 reuses main's pin_tree.
options.label: Stay local (triage's pick; main today)
options.lose: A lane can pass lint on a tree CI pins differently.

options.how: Lane lint reads the pinned trees, as #1938 builds.
options.label: Follow pinned trees
options.lose: Child repos stick on old pinned rules (against R44).

title: Should lane lint follow the pinned trees, or stay local to the checkout?
why: Backlog-drain lane ledger in #3154; no past ruling settles it (triage read of rulings, steps and main's decisions 11:30 CST Nov 13). #1916 and #2017 turn on a second question, whether lane lint runs other jobs' suites; decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job says touched suites only, and they wait on this answer.
